import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import norm

# 设置均值和标准差
mean = 20000
std_dev = 5102

# 生成一些数据点
x = np.linspace(mean - 3 * std_dev, mean + 3 * std_dev, 1000)

# 计算累积概率
cumulative_prob = norm.cdf(x, mean, std_dev)

# 绘制累积概率分布图
plt.plot(x, cumulative_prob)
plt.title('Cumulative Probability Distribution of Normal Distribution')
plt.xlabel('Value')
plt.ylabel('Cumulative Probability')
plt.grid(True)

# 标注累积概率为70%的点
target_prob = 0.7
target_value = norm.ppf(target_prob, mean, std_dev)
plt.scatter(target_value, target_prob, color='red', label=f'70% Cumulative Probability: {target_value:.2f}')
plt.legend()

# 增加连接x轴的虚线
plt.axhline(y=target_prob, color='gray', linestyle='--', xmax=(target_value - (mean - 3 * std_dev)) / (6 * std_dev))

# 增加连接y轴的虚线
plt.axvline(x=target_value, color='gray', linestyle='--', ymax=target_prob)

# 在图上标注各自的值
plt.text(target_value, 0, f'{target_value:.2f}', verticalalignment='bottom', horizontalalignment='center', color='black', fontsize=9)
plt.text(0, target_prob, f'{target_prob:.2f}', verticalalignment='center', horizontalalignment='right', color='black', fontsize=9)

plt.show()

import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import norm

# 设置均值和标准差
mean = 20000
std_dev = 5102

# 生成一些数据点
x = np.linspace(mean - 3 * std_dev, mean + 3 * std_dev, 1000)

# 计算正态分布的概率密度函数值
y = norm.pdf(x, mean, std_dev)

# 计算累积概率
cumulative_prob =norm.cdf(22675, mean, std_dev)

# 绘制正态分布的图像
plt.plot(x, y, label=f"Probability Density Function")
plt.fill_between(x, 0, y, where=(x <= 22675), color='skyblue', alpha=0.4, label=f"Cumulative Probability: {cumulative_prob:.4f}")
plt.title("Cumulative Probability Visualization")
plt.xlabel("Value")
plt.ylabel("Probability Density Function")
plt.legend()
plt.grid(True)
plt.show()
